name: cam-execution-gateway
description: Fail-closed, instance-targeted command review and dry-run execution gateway for CAM.

interface.shortDescription: Review instance-targeted CAM commands through a dry-run gate.
interface.longDescription: Adds a fail-closed execution gateway that independently blocks destructive and machine-output commands, records decisions, and requires an explicit CAM instance plus versioned transport for live execution.
interface.defaultPrompt: Audit this CAM command request without executing it.
